# C1 compacting test: five sequential tool-help calls
Folder: private
Description: A context-compacting stress test (C1) that required five sequential tool-help calls with the queries 'list', 'search', 'chat', 'image', and 'audio'. Each call was issued one at a time and all five returned valid tool listings, confirming the tool-help endpoint responds correctly across categories. T
